items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: You ain't got no respect for this man, Red Garland. You ain't got no respect for me. You ain't got no respect for him. We done sit up and played two sets in this place.

ctx.x: See I wasn't feeling well. So we got up and played a set. I go back in the kitchen,man,and sit back there and mess around. And finally we go back and play another set . Finally at 3:30 in the morning, telling us come out there and play some more. I look at this lady, I say look here you know, that's the same reason why you all ain't got no respect for the musicians.
